channel.title: Honey
channel.desc: Martha is annoyed after Kurt steals their joint credit for locating Kamilla, and she vows to gain access to the scientist alone. A competitive Kurt promises to do the same. Friedrich is ordered by his boss Schimmel to ramp up his efforts to locate Greta, believing she is the key to the Hermann Metzl case. Eager for a win, Martha and Kurt attempt to insinuate their way into Friedrich's confidence to find Greta. Stung by his reaction, Martha steals a prized possession.
